fullDescription: A high-fidelity dark-themed event management dashboard and interactive scheduling system. Featuring a deep navy aesthetic (#020617) with vibrant neon accents in cyan (#06b6d4) and teal (#14b8a6), this design is optimized for community hubs, university platforms, and professional event networks. It utilizes 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for a modern, tech-forward editorial look. Key layout features include a persistent vertical navigation sidebar, a sticky header with a unique dual-pane interactive calendar dropdown, and a responsive bento-style grid for event discovery. The visual language relies on glassmorphism principles, thin borders (1px solid #1e293b), and subtle glow animations.

structured.summary: An interactive, dark-mode event dashboard featuring a complex calendar system, categorized event cards, and community-driven widgets with high-contrast cyan highlights.

style.description: The style is characterized by a 'Midnight' dark mode palette using #020617 and #0f172a. Typography uses 'Plus Jakarta Sans' with heavy emphasis on weight contrast (300 to 800) and small-caps tracking for labels. Accents are primarily Cyan (#06b6d4) for primary actions and Teal (#14b8a6) or Rose (#e11d48) for category coding. UI elements feature 24px-32px rounded corners, 1px borders for structure, and smooth 0.3s ease-out transitions for hover states and modals.
style.prompt:
### Visual Foundation
- **Base Theme**: Dark mode only. Background: #020617 (Deepest Navy). Component backgrounds: #0f172a (Navy Surface). 
- **Color Palette**: 
  - Primary Accent: #06b6d4 (Cyan 400)
  - Secondary Accent: #14b8a6 (Teal 500)
  - Alert/Cultural Accent: #e11d48 (Rose 600)
  - Muted Text: #64748b (Slate 500)
  - Borders: 1px solid #1e293b (Slate 800)
- **Typography**: Font family 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Use font-weight: 800 for page headings, 600 for card titles, and 400 for descriptions. Labels should be 10px, uppercase, tracking-widest, font-weight 700.
- **Interactive Effects**:
  - Hover: Use 0.3s ease-out for color shifts and scale(1.05) on card images.
  - Glow: Active states (like the selected calendar day) use `box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4)` and a linear-gradient(135deg, #06b6d4 0%, #14b8a6 100%).
  - Animation: Modal entry uses a 'slideDown' effect (translateY from -10px to 0 and opacity 0 to 1).

layout_and_structure.description: The layout consists of a fixed left sidebar (280px) and a main content area that begins with a sticky 80px top header. Content is organized into a primary event grid followed by a multi-column bento section for auxiliary widgets.

prompts.partPt: Left Menu Lateral Menu do Topo
prompts.prompt:
### Sidebar (Fixed, 280px)
- **Container**: Background #0f172a, border-right: 1px #1e293b.
- **Logo Section**: 40px rounded-xl cyan box with white icon. Title: 20px bold white.
- **Nav Items**: 12px vertical padding. Active item: Cyan-400 text with bg-cyan-950/30 (low opacity overlay). Inactive: Slate-400 with hover state scaling the icon 1.1x.
- **Section Labels**: 10px uppercase, bold, slate-600. 32px top padding between sections.
- **Bottom Widget**: Gradient card (Cyan to Teal), 16px padding, white text, 8px rounded buttons.

### Top Header (Sticky, 80px)
- **Layout**: Space-between flexbox. Left: Profile trigger with 40px circular avatar and name/info stack. Right: Search bar and utility buttons.
- **Calendar Trigger**: A 160px-200px wide interactive button. Left side: Day/Month stack (uppercase teal text). Right side: Calendar icon in a 32px cyan-accented box. Hovering this trigger should prepare the modal toggle.
- **Search Bar**: 256px width, pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-slate-900, icon-left, placeholder text in slate-500.

### Hero Event Section
- **Header**: 30px extra-bold white title. Sub-caption in slate-400.
- **Grid**: 3-column responsive layout. 
- **Card Structure**: 
  - Top: 176px image container with 50% opacity overlay.
  - Badges: Absolute positioned top-left, pill-shaped, colored based on category (Cyan for Academic, Rose for Cultural, Teal for Startup).
  - Body: 24px padding. 18px bold title. Meta-info (time/location) using icons and 11px semi-bold font.
  - Footer: Avatar stack (-8px overlap) on left; Action button (Register/Joined) on right.

### Lower Dashboard Components
- **Skill Corner**: Large surface card spanning 3/4 width. Inner grid of 2 sub-cards with 48px square icons and bold labels.
- **Status Panel**: 1/4 width. Simple list-based dashboard showing stats (Points, Bookmarks) with high-contrast text values.
- **Anonymous Widget**: Gradient background (Slate-900 to Black), floating 'Ghost' icon with 10% opacity, glassmorphism-style call-to-action button.

special_ui_components.description: A 700px wide dropdown modal combining date selection and event preview.
special_ui_components.prompt:
### Calendar Modal Implementation
- **Container**: 700px width, bg #1e293b, 24px rounded-3xl, shadow: heavy black blur. Split into two vertical panes.
- **Left Pane (Date Selector)**: 320px width. 
  - Header: Month/Year title with chevron navigation buttons.
  - Grid: 7-column layout. Header (Su-Sa) in 10px bold slate-500.
  - Date Cells: 12px font. Active day has a cyan-to-teal gradient background, white text, and shadow. 
  - Indicators: Underneath the date number, render up to 3 colored dots (1px radius) to signify multiple events.
- **Right Pane (Schedule View)**: bg #0f172a/40.
  - Header: 'Schedule for [Selected Date]' in Cyan caps.
  - Event List: Scrollable area with compact event cards. Cards include 48px square preview images, category labels, and title. Empty state: Center-aligned calendar-x icon with 'No events' text at 40% opacity.

special_ui_components.description: Cards that use glowing borders or shadows to signify high-importance events.
special_ui_components.prompt:
### Neon Card Detail
- **Style**: Applies to specific event cards. Use `border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3)` and `box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.1)` on hover. The title color should transition from white to cyan-400 on hover. The image zoom effect should be precisely 1.05x with a 500ms duration.
